spanish: Y si toda congregación de Israel erraren, y se ocultare cosa desde ojos de la asamblea, e hicieren una desde todos mandamientos de Jehová que no se harán, y serán culpados:
grammarChanges: errare -> erraren: 3rd-plural future subjunctive to match Qal imperfect 3mp יִשְׁגּוּ, consistent with the already-plural hicieren later in the verse.
culpados -> serán culpados: added the finite verb serán so the Qal sequential perfect 3cp וְאָשֵׁמוּ is rendered as a finite verb rather than a bare participle.
readerNote: Kept the plural erraren against the singular head noun congregación to match the Hebrew 3mp verb, the same choice already reflected in hicieren.
